text:
maria (AE): Quick flag 10 NimbusHealth wants to close pilot. They returned an orderform with a few unusual asks: they want a shorter SLA (99.6%) for the pilot term only, a DPA clause allowing customer-managed KMS for hosted, and an addendum for stricter data residency (EU-only). Procurement also asked if we can accept Adobe Sign. PO requested net60. Link: https://example.com/nimbus/orderform-redline.pdf

tom (AM): net60 is tough. For pilot we can maybe do net45, but net60 would set a precedent. Also data residency: do we have an EU-hosted option available for POC?

evan (SE): We have an EU region for Hosted, but their KMS request isn't compatible with our Hosted multi-tenant offering. KMS requires dedicated/private. If they insist on customer-managed keys, we should propose Dedicated or Private. Also note: EU-only data routing will change our billing and support scope.

anya (Legal): Reviewing their redline. Proposed approach: accept SLA tweak for 30 days only (99.6%) then back to 99.9%; decline hosted KMS and offer a clear carve that KMS is supported only for Dedicated/Private; accept EU data residency for the pilot if they sign a regional data addendum and agree to potential additional fees. Indemnity: they struck our indemnity cap; we'll push back and propose 1x fees cap.

trent (Security): Need SIG-lite + SOC2 Type II. If they require EU-only data residency we must confirm where logs, backups, and metrics are stored. Also confirm subprocessors for EU region. For e-sign: DocuSign preferred, but we can do Adobe Sign with manual ingestion.
